description: This file defines the AnyCommand class, which provides a user interface component (a command input field with a button) for sending commands within a Java Swing application. It manages user input validation, command preparation (including evaluative expressions and reverse polish notation conversions), and integrates with a command queue for execution. The class also supports recent commands navigation and optional command captioning.

classes.name: AnyCommand
classes.description: A Swing UI component that allows users to input, validate, and send commands, with support for recent command history and command processing features.

methods.name: installCtrlEnterAction
methods.description: Sets up a key binding on the text component to send the command when Ctrl+Enter is pressed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the content of the input text, splitting multi-line input into individual commands.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Processes and queues an individual command string for execution, ensuring validity.

methods.name: prepareCommand
methods.description: Prepares a command string for execution, handling special prefixes like 'eval' and 'set_fsio_expression'.

methods.name: prepareSetFsioCommand
methods.description: Transforms a 'set_fsio_expression' command into an RPN expression command.

methods.name: prepareEvalCommand
methods.description: Transforms an 'eval' command into an RPN evaluation command.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Wraps a string in double quotes.

methods.name: infix2postfix
methods.description: Converts an infix mathematical expression to postfix notation using DoubleEvaluator.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string if present.

methods.name: isValidInput
methods.description: Validates that the input string contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component (content panel) of the command input.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the main UI component (not typically used externally).

methods.name: requestFocus
methods.description: Requests focus for the text input component.

methods.name: createField
methods.description: Creates a text field for command input, with recent command navigation.

methods.name: createArea
methods.description: Creates a multiline text area for command input.
